description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveRequestService in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It contains unit tests for methods related to leave request handling, including retrieving leave statuses, detailed leave requests, and allowed workflows.

classes.name: LeaveRequestServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LeaveRequestService covering methods for leave status retrieval, detailed leave requests, workflows, and leave data processing.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Tests that getLeaveRequestDao returns an instance of LeaveRequestDao.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all leave statuses as an associative array.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Tests getting the name of a leave status by its status ID, including exception handling for invalid IDs.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving leave status ID by name, including exception handling for invalid names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple leave status IDs by names, including invalid names handling.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Tests assembling detailed leave request data from leave records.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Tests filtering of allowed workflows based on user role and leave type, with various states.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflowsWithDeletedLeaveType
methods.description: Tests filtering workflows when the leave type has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: getMockWorkflowActions
methods.description: Helper method to generate mock workflow actions for testing.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Tests associating leaves with detailed leave request objects.
